name: pctf-tourism-prototype
description: Privacy-preserving Contact Tracing Framework (PCTF) for smart tourism: research prototype and evaluation

scripts.figures: python3 scripts/figures/fig_results.py results figures && cd figures/src && pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode -output-directory .. fig1_system_model.tex && pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode -output-directory .. fig2_key_release_protocol.tex
scripts.verify: node scripts/analysis/anonymity.js results && python3 scripts/analysis/validate_models.py results && python3 formal/verify_properties.py results && node formal/check_key_release.js results
